title: The thirsty crow
subject: literacy
materials: a small pot and a few pebbles if you have them
chalk_sketch_svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 120 40" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"><path d="M60 34V16c0-6 12-6 12 0v18z"/><circle cx="30" cy="30" r="3"/><circle cx="40" cy="31" r="3"/><circle cx="20" cy="31" r="3"/></svg>

segments.title: The crow finds a pot

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: A crow was very thirsty. It flew and flew. It found a pot with a little water at the bottom.

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: The crow could not reach the water. What should the crow do? Think.

segments.checkpoint: Did most children have an idea?

easier.speaker: guide
easier.text: Its beak is short. The water is low. What could make the water come up?

core.speaker: guide
core.text: Good ideas. Let us listen to what the crow did.

stretch.speaker: guide
stretch.text: Tell your partner your idea, and why it could work.

segments.title: The crow drops stones

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: The crow saw some pebbles. It dropped them into the pot, one by one.
teach.cue: Drop a pebble in a pot if you have one

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: தண்ணீர் மேலே வந்தது. காகம் தண்ணீர் குடித்தது.

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: The water came up. The crow drank and flew away happy.

segments.checkpoint: Did most children say the crow dropped stones?

easier.speaker: guide
easier.text: What did the crow drop in the pot? Stones. Say stones.

core.speaker: guide
core.text: Why did the water come up? Because the stones took up space.

stretch.speaker: guide
stretch.text: What is the lesson of the story? Think and tell your partner.

segments.title: Tell it back

teach.speaker: guide
teach.text: Tell the story to your partner. First, next, last.

segments.checkpoint: Did most pairs retell the story?

easier.speaker: guide
easier.text: Start together. First, the crow was thirsty. Next?

core.speaker: guide
core.text: Well done. One pair can tell it to the class.

stretch.speaker: guide
stretch.text: Now change the story. What if the pot had no pebbles near it?

analogy.speaker: guide
analogy.text: It is like drinking juice with a straw. If the juice is low, you cannot reach it. Add something and it rises.

ivr_recap.speaker: guide
ivr_recap.text: Ask your family: what did the crow do when it was thirsty?
